content.text:
Perfect! The fix is working. The issue was floating-point precision: when multiplying 39.95 by 100, JavaScript was getting 3995.0000000000005 instead of exactly 3995, which failed the integer check.

The solution was to wrap the cents calculation in `Math.round()` to eliminate floating-point precision errors. I applied this fix to both:

1. **`parseEuros()`** (line 13) - for prices typed on the command line
2. **`cellCents()`** (line 25) - for prices imported from CSV files

All tests pass, and you can now successfully add 39.95 prices—or any other price that previously suffered from floating-point rounding errors.
